BiblicalUsage: Kerah means a purchase, a provision bought for the table. 2 Kings 6:23 says Elisha prepared great provision for the Syrian raiders, and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe feeding your enemies is stronger than fighting them: the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.
